We rewrite our integral and integrate term by term to get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{5{x}^{2}+6}{{x}^{2}(2x+3)}\,\text{d}x & =\int (-\frac{4}{3x}+\frac{2}{{x}^{2}}+\frac{23}{3(2x+3)})\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{4}{3}\int \frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x+2\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x+\frac{23}{3}\int \frac{1}{2x+3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{4}{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡|x|-\frac{2}{x}+\frac{23}{6}\operatorname{ln}⁡|2x+3|+C.\end{aligned}
$$
